summary: Toggles the read-only attribute (bit 0) of a file through the Win32 file API. Reads the current attributes with GetFileAttributesA; if the read fails (-1) it falls through to the error path. Otherwise it sets the read-only bit when a2 is non-negative (OR 1) and clears it when a2 is negative (AND 0xFE), applies the change with SetFileAttributesA and returns 0 on success. On any failure it records the Win32 error via GetLastError plus ErrorIDLookupTable and returns -1.

operations.description: Call GetFileAttributesA(lpFileName) to read the current file attributes; returns -1 on failure.
If the returned attributes equal -1 (INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES), skip the toggle and fall through to the error path.
Toggle the read-only bit (bit 0): if a2 >= 0 set it (attrs | 1), otherwise clear it (attrs & 0xFE).
Call SetFileAttributesA(lpFileName, attrs) to apply the modified attributes.
Call GetLastError() to capture the failure code from the failed Win32 call.
Call ErrorIDLookupTable(GetLastError()) to map the Win32 error code to an internal error ID and log it.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the a2 flag across callers is not established: the raw source only dictates the bit-0 decision (non-negative sets, negative clears read-only).
The ABI lead carries LEGACY trust and is consistent with the raw source, so no conflict is recorded.
